variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
